Author: Serpens66
Name: Multiplayer Leave Fix
Description: Prevents repeated multiplayer leave and connection issue system messages from flooding the in-game chat.

Changes: Limited intentional-leave detection to successfully processed main-thread packets and short duplicate windows, including safe rejoin and reused-slot handling.
Kept the native multiplayer leave hooks rooted after SHCDE destroys the early BepInEx plugin object during startup.
Limit repeated in-game system messages when a multiplayer player leaves or has a connection issue.
